description: Win-probability timeline (the broadcast worm) for a men's T20 chase: one point per match state you send, from the same model as hsh-cricket-chase-winprob. Per call.

events.description: 1 to 400 match states [{balls_bowled, wickets, cum_runs}], one point back per state, in the order sent; balls_bowled is legal balls (12.3 overs = 75). A `target` inside a state may be left out; if sent, it must equal the call's.

venue.description: The ground's name, applied to every state.

name: hsh-cricket-timeline
